doc.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Goodbyes
summary: Rowe thanks him; they chat about where Rowe is based.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has really been a great pleasure, talking to you.
Oh thank you. It’s great going over my fabulous life.
Well I wish you the best of luck.
And I hope to get to hear you play sometime soon.
Yeah. So where are you based at? You are based in New York?
Yeah, just near Syracuse, near Utica actually.
Boy I used to play what’s that Rensselaer Polytech.
